title: Building Fantastical Worlds
content: Communication Artsmagazine has just posted an article by Lisa Cyr based on interviews with Spiderwick creator Tony DiTerlizzi and me.The article explores how imaginary worlds from illustrated books can develop into other media, such as  film and games."Building Fantastical Worlds" at CATony DiTerlizzi's official websiteWondla to be adapted by ParamountImages from Simon & Schuster and Paramount
